answer: The grove register is checked at draw time, fable lists the eligible set, and ivory seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 28 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 28 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone burns for every seat it wants. A 438 account operation therefore ties up 24 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
